verdict.rationale: Brevo documents its own segmentation that filters contacts by demographics, website activity, campaign engagement and custom events, plus engagement-based scores usable for segments. That covers profile attributes and behavioral events. Nothing in the pack says segments update live as data changes or that tags can be used as filters. missing for 10: evidence that segments refresh dynamically as contact data changes, tag-based segment filters, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a marketer, I can build audience segments from profile attributes, tags, and behavioral events, and they stay live as data changes

citations.quote: Search, save, and manage contacts with filters like demographics, website activity, campaign engagement, and custom events. Create as many segments as you need.
Get contact scores based on engagement, purchases, and behaviors to trigger automations or create targeted segments.
Track custom user events and behaviors.
